description: This header file declares internal API functions for the Bbhm UDP Echo server object used in the Broadband Home Manager Model. It includes prototypes for managing the UDP echo server's lifecycle, diagnostics, and configuration retrieval.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoEngage
methods.description: Activates the UDP Echo server object.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoCancel
methods.description: Cancels or deactivates the UDP Echo server object.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoStartDiag
methods.description: Starts the diagnostic process in the UDP Echo server.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoGetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result handle of the diagnostic operation.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoRetrieveResult
methods.description: Retrieves or processes the diagnostic result.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoGetConfig
methods.description: Gets the current configuration for the UDP Echo server.

methods.name: BbhmUdpechoSetConfig
methods.description: Sets or updates the configuration for the UDP Echo server.
